PROFILE
Chartered environmental health practitioner with nine years' experience
in food safety enforcement, outbreak investigation and training of food
business operators. Comfortable leading multi-agency investigations and
presenting evidence in magistrates' court. Seeking a senior food safety
role in local government or the public health sector.

EXPERIENCE

Senior Environmental Health Officer (Food & Safety)
Cherwell Vale District Council, Banbury          April 2021 - present
- Lead a team of four officers responsible for 1,350 food businesses.
- Coordinated the investigation of a Salmonella outbreak linked to a
  wedding caterer (41 cases), working with the UKHSA health protection
  team; prosecution resulted in a £24,000 fine.
- Introduced a risk-based remote assessment process that cleared a
  backlog of 310 overdue inspections within eight months.
- Deliver Level 2 and Level 3 food hygiene courses to local businesses.

Environmental Health Officer
Royal Borough of Kingsmere, Food Safety Team     Sept 2017 - March 2021
- Carried out food hygiene and standards inspections, complaint
  investigations and sampling programmes.
- Served improvement and hygiene emergency prohibition notices.
- Primary authority liaison for a regional bakery chain.

Graduate Environmental Health Practitioner (trainee)
Thamesbury City Council                             Sept 2015 - Aug 2017
